task_recognized.title: Pinwheels (nut butter and jelly tortilla roll-ups)

actions.text: Looks like you're making pinwheels. Want me to walk you through it?
Take one 8-inch flour tortilla and lay it flat on the cutting board. Don't heat it, just use it as it is.
Pick up a butter knife, open the nut butter jar, and scoop out a good spoonful of nut butter on the blade.
Spread the nut butter in an even layer over the tortilla, but stop about half an inch before the edge all the way around.
Wipe the nut butter off the butter knife with a paper towel so it's clean for the jelly.
